values.note: Fair's rate table (shared with ChoCoFair Campground): RV no hookups $25, RV with water or electric $30, water and electric $35, full hookups $40, tent $15; RV dump $5. Canoe Launch's RV sites are described as 'most with water and electrical hookups', with no sewer mentioned, so the $40 full-hookup tier is left out of the high.

values.note: A vault toilet is a short walk from every site; the RV dump station ($5) is on the main fairgrounds property. The operator's page lists no showers here.

note: Chouteau County Fair-operated campground in Fort Benton beside the Missouri River canoe launch (river mile 0 of the Upper Missouri Breaks); a separate site from the fair's ChoCoFair Campground at the fairgrounds. Free day-use parking by the launch ramp for boaters and floaters; the launch is a popular summer tubing spot. Seasonal (May-Nov). --Claude
summary: County fair-run, all sites first-come first-served. Confirmed FCFS/not reservable, water at sites, dump; changed fees high 40->35 (the earlier read was the ChoCoFair Campground page; Canoe Launch has water+electric, no sewer stated), added 14 sites (8 back-in RV, 6 tent), no pull-throughs, vault toilet; cleared derived showers (the operator's facility list here is a vault toilet only). Not stated: amperage for this campground, season dates, max rig length. Note: dropped the '~7 RV sites ... ~25 tent sites; clean restrooms, hot showers' line the page contradicts.
flags: Website is the fair's general camping page; the campground's own page is https://www.chocofair.com/canoe-launch-campground.

Earlier fees provenance (2026-10-15) cited https://www.chocofair.com/chocofair-campground, which is the fair's OTHER campground; the rate table is shared, but sites/amenities there (14 back-in sites, showers) are not Canoe Launch's.
